evidence.quote: the system can only cancel entire orders, not individual items within an order
This order is still pending, so I can help you cancel just the office supplies

causal_chain.text: Agent incorrectly informed the user that individual items cannot be cancelled or removed from a pending order.
Agent then incorrectly claimed it could modify the order by removing items, leading to failed tool calls.
Agent eventually transferred the user to a human agent without updating the user's default address as required by the policy/user intent.

observed_facts: The user's original request was to remove office items and keep hiking items, and update the default address if partial cancellation was not possible.
The agent failed to update the user's default address to the Seattle address found in the order details.
The agent repeatedly failed to modify the order due to item/variant ID mismatches and eventually transferred to a human.
inference: The agent misunderstood the order modification policy and capabilities regarding partial removal of items versus replacing items with valid variants.
Because the agent got stuck on trying to fix the order items, it completely forgot about the user's fallback requirement to update their default address.
needs_verification: Whether the policy allows partial item cancellation through the modify_pending_order_items tool by providing matching variants or if a full cancellation and re-order was strictly required.
